description: Revoke an API key by id. An owner or admin revokes any key of the organization; a member revokes only a key they minted, and another key returns not_found. Irreversible, and touches only that key: keys minted with it stay enabled until revoked by id. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.
name: revoke_api_key
title: Revoke API key
